fusions.name: Thickened Air
fusions.desc: Breathes thick arcana in a cone 4 tiles ahead, using up one of your afflictions on each target to deal 7 damage. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Stalled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Spell Left Simmering
fusions.desc: Lays a spell on an enemy within 7 tiles that deals 30 damage, ignoring resistance, 6 seconds later. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target carries by then, up to 50%.

fusions.name: Everything Waits
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to cast, then holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. Afterwards each one is [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Trickle
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, you restore 2 mana a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
